title: accessibilityLabel on every icon-only control
roadmap_anchor: Q2 > Accessibility > accessibilityLabel on every icon-only control
acceptance: Every icon-only control has an accessibilityLabel: star, AA, ellipsis, plus, and the filter menu at minimum
Labels describe the action, not the glyph
Controls whose meaning toggles announce their current state
A grep for Image(systemName:) inside a Button with no label returns nothing
notes: Zero labels exist today. Additive, low-blast-radius, mechanically verifiable — second calibration candidate.
